id./param/scenario/cs/b_170_cs_090.pack|cs_:
"What a strange mural.
  I can't take my eyes off it...

"While searching these ruins, I found
  a book written by the Watchers.
  It says...

"'A spirit born of Erdrea's earth,
  weaving the flow of endless time.
  Its name: the embodiment of lost time.'

"The embodiment of lost time...
  Is that what's in the mural?

"In the Watchers' lore: what the
  embodiment of lost time guards
  is a sacred light that governs time.

"When that light shines and burns,
  what was lost in the distant past
  shall be greatly restored...

"Restored...? Does that light have
  the power to bring back
  what was lost?
"If that's true, then she...!

"...Remember. There are dear friends
  we long to see again with all our hearts!
"...Veronica!
"Sister... might come back to life?

"Rab, dear! Doesn't it say anything
  more about that light's power!?

"'Sacred light that governs time.
  It shines quietly in the Tower of Lost Time.'

"'When you obtain the mysterious wheel
  the Watchers guarded since ancient times...

"'...head for the Tower of Lost Time,
  where the spirits of lost time gather.'

"The Wheel of Time... a clue
  to bringing Sister back...

"If there's even a little hope,
  we should stake everything on it.
  That's how my fate changed.

"Even a tiny hope, if it means
  seeing Sister again...
  I want to stake everything on it!

"But where is the Wheel of Time
  anyway?

"The wheel the Watchers guarded...
  so the old text says.
  And that hole in the rock wall...

"The wheel may be
  somewhere near here.

"We can go deeper from there.
  There might be a clue. Let's go!
